title: Keeping Things Hot and Cold
summary: Insulation in action: vacuum flasks, kulhads, thermocol, woollens and the cooling clay matka.

ib.note: Rates of cooling are analysed graphically in MYP 4–5

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 7: Heat Transfer in Nature

objectives: I can explain how insulators reduce heat transfer by conduction, convection and radiation.
I can explain how a vacuum flask and a clay matka work.
I can interpret cooling curves to compare insulating materials.
misconceptions: A flask keeps drinks hot by heating them.
A matka cools water because clay is cold.
